checklist:
# ReUI post-install checklist

Reuse-first: adapt the installed ReUI code; never redesign or hand-roll what ReUI already provides.

- [ ] Read the added files; keep the composition intact (do not edit installed component files, hooks, or shared theme).
- [ ] Preserved the design: changed data/copy/props, NOT the block's structure or styling. Reused the block's own elements and c-* examples. Over-customizing turns a premium block generic.
- [ ] No invented APIs or names: every prop, variant, import, and @reui name came from get_component's inline api, an installed example, or a search result. Run validate_usage when unsure.
- [ ] Replace ALL demo data with the user's real data via typed structures; map over arrays, do not duplicate JSX.
- [ ] data-grid: build a TanStack v9 `useTable({ features: dataGridFeatures, ... })` instance and pass `<DataGrid table={table} recordCount={...}>`; never `<DataGrid data=... columns=... />`.
- [ ] Fix icon imports to the project's icon library; do not hand-compose icon mappings.
- [ ] Align to semantic tokens / the active theme - no raw colors; use ReUI extended tokens where relevant.
- [ ] Believable content: realistic labels, counts, timestamps, statuses. No decorative buttons, fake tabs, equal-weight card walls, or generic SaaS filler.
- [ ] Accessibility: real anchors, `aria-label` on icon/numeric buttons, `aria-hidden` on decorative icons, `type="button"` on non-submit buttons.
- [ ] Security: no `dangerouslySetInnerHTML`; external links use `rel="noopener noreferrer"`; no real PII or secrets.
- [ ] Scroll regions: parent-owned height via `min-h-0` + a flex chain; never guess `max-h`.
- [ ] Typecheck + lint; adapt naming, layout, and responsiveness to the app.
